description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models, including Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3 with tick labels at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and has a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80 with a tick label interval of 5. The plot shows six lines, each representing a different model, with distinct colors and marker shapes: Base (black, circle), FT (blue, triangle down), IKE (red, triangle up), MEND (brown, diamond), MEMIT (purple, triangle right), and ROME (green, square). The Base line starts at around 60% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 66% at 3 × 10^3. The FT line begins at around 61% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to about 69% at 3 × 10^3. The IKE line starts at roughly 64% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and reaches around 70% at 3 × 10^3. The MEND line begins at approximately 65% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to about 75% at 3 × 10^3. The MEMIT line starts at around 65% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to approximately 73% at 3 × 10^3. The ROME line begins at roughly 72% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and reaches around 78% at 3 × 10^3, before slightly decreasing to about 77% at 3 × 10^3. All lines generally exhibit an upward trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
